onboarding_welcome_body: Keep your medication schedule and records safely on this device
onboarding_feature_offline: Your medication data stays on this device
onboarding_feature_reminders: Get reminders when it is time to take medicine
onboarding_feature_stock: Track doses and remaining medication stock
onboarding_notifications_body: Allow notifications so Med Reminder can alert you when it is time to take medicine
onboarding_permission_not_enabled: Permission is not enabled. You can enable it later in system settings.
onboarding_precise_body: On Android you can optionally allow Alarms & reminders for more precise delivery. Without it the app uses battery-friendly inexact reminders.
onboarding_precise_optional: Optional. The app still works without this permission.
onboarding_ready_body: Add your medication and choose the times you want to be reminded
